# Vision Managers

> Most businesses are leaking $100K+ a year — missed calls, follow-up that never happens, work still done by hand, knowledge trapped in one person's head. Vision Managers finds the leaks and builds the systems that fix them: marketing, operations and knowledge made clearer and more scalable, using AI as the implementation tool, not the headline.

Vision Managers is a Seattle-area consultancy run by Sukh Virk (ex-Meta, ex-CVS Health conversation design and UX research). Work arrives mostly by referral. One person is accountable for the result; every engagement starts with a free rung.

## Start free

- **The Leak Audit** (https://visionmanagers.com/leak-audit): self-serve — pick your business type, see where money is leaking, in your own numbers. ~3 minutes, no email needed.
- **Vendor & Spend Audit**: what you pay for phones, connectivity and services, re-quoted through supplier lanes. Free to the client (the supplier pays the fee); any switching costs are quoted up front.
- **Free 20-minute discovery call**: a working session, not a pitch. Within a day you get an AI Opportunity Snapshot — your biggest opportunity, sized in dollars, in writing.

## Services & pricing (fixed, published)

- **AI Quick-Start — $500, one week**: where AI makes or saves you money, with dollar math, and one quick win implemented the same week.
- **Your Bid Bot — from $1,000 per document type** (https://visionmanagers.com/bid-bot): a bid/estimate writer for trades and home services, trained on the owner's own past bids and rate sheet. Formal bids in their format, their prices, same day; the owner approves every number. Built done-for-you in about a week. Priced by what a document costs today: Standard $1,000 · Heavy $1,500 · Anchor from $2,250.
- **Bid Desk — $650/month, month-to-month**: automated follow-up (email + text) on every estimate sent, in the owner's voice, with a monthly won/lost review. The reported metric is jobs the system won.
- **The 72-Hour Market Test — $2,500** (https://visionmanagers.com/market-test): market-test a business idea in 72 hours — demand evidence, competitor teardown, 20–30 verbatim customer quotes, pricing corridors, a same-week sales kit, and a GO / REFRAME / KILL verdict. Guarantee: a clear verdict and 20+ sourced quotes, or you don't pay. Founding-cohort pricing currently available.
- **Build Sprint — $1,500–$4,500 fixed**: voice agents, automation, websites, data systems; ships with a monthly recovered-revenue report.
- **Expansion OS — $7,500, six months, 8 seats** (https://visionmanagers.com/expansion-os): a hands-on build cohort; owners ship two working systems with weekly guidance.
- **AI Partner — from $1,000/month · Strategic AI Partner — from $5,000/month** (https://visionmanagers.com/partner): ongoing accountable ownership of the AI roadmap.
- **Voice AI agents — from $1,000 setup + $300–400/month**: every call answered and booked, with the compliance posture healthcare demands. A shown capability, deployed when the audit points to it.
- **Casual Intelligence** (https://visionmanagers.com/ci): a weekly community for business owners learning to use AI well.

## Who it serves

Owners and operators of real, revenue-generating businesses across verticals — trades and home services, agencies, recruiting, legal, insurance, software, healthcare practices, franchises. Healthcare depth is compliance credibility (HIPAA-aware architectures), not a limitation.

## Proven results (permissioned)

- Optometry practice, Seattle area: 5 new-patient appointments and $4,300+ in scheduled visit value within days of the voice agent going live.
- Wolf & Wolf (roofing & exteriors, Eastside): a custom bid writer built from and tested against 745 of the owner's own past bids — "This was a very easy process. I'm impressed with your professionalism and I'm excited to use my new AI helper."
